title: Industrial Application - Haber Process
body: The Haber process for ammonia synthesis is: N2(g) + 3H2(g) <=> 2NH3(g), delta H = -92 kJ. In industry, conditions of 450 degrees C and 200 atm pressure are used with an iron catalyst. Explain why a moderate temperature (450 degrees C) is used rather than a low temperature.
oer: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Chemical Equilibrium
